name: Community Children
eligibility: Children officially identified by the school as community children. This waiver covers tuition only; other approved school fees remain payable.

name: Family of Four
eligibility: Families with four enrolled children, where the school has approved one specific child for the free tuition benefit. Do not apply this waiver to the other siblings automatically.

name: Family of Three
eligibility: Families with three enrolled children. The 10% reduction applies to each eligible child's tuition after the family has been confirmed by the school.

name: Teacher's Child
eligibility: Children of teachers who have been approved for the staff-child benefit. This reduces total school fees by 50%, including non-tuition fees covered by the account.

name: Teacher's Child - Full
eligibility: Specific children of teachers who have been individually approved for full fee support. This makes total school fees free; it does not apply to every teacher's child automatically.
